### 2026-10-02 — esp 8266 with a 0.96 oled displaying pics now you can edit in the pin configuration as you like aswell the dimintions of the screen incase you are using a diffrent type of oled. 1- connect to the esp

**4.5h**

esp 8266 with a 0.96 oled displaying pics now you can edit in the pin configuration as you like aswell the dimintions of the screen incase you are using a diffrent type of oled. 1- connect to the esp "ESP8266-OLED-Frame" and password 12345678 to connect (you can edit it in the code this block :const char* AP_SSID = "ESP8266-OLED-Frame"; const char* AP_PASS = "12345678"; ) thats it enjoy!!
